title: First Word All Beings Say Bismillah Through The Language Of Their State

questions.question: At the start of this passage, what question is being asked about all things?
questions.answer: Whether all created things, in their own way, say Allah’s name.

questions.question: In the example about one person moving a whole town, why would we know he is not acting by himself?
questions.answer: Because one person could not do that alone, so he must be using the ruler’s power.

questions.question: In that example, who is the man acting for?
questions.answer: He is acting for the government and under the king’s power.

questions.question: What does that example teach about the things in the world?
questions.answer: They work by Allah’s command and power, not by themselves.

questions.question: What tiny things are named that carry something much bigger than themselves?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: What big thing comes from those tiny things?
questions.answer: Large trees.

questions.question: What are gardens compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: Big cooking pots where many foods are prepared.

questions.question: What kinds of animals are mentioned as giving milk?
questions.answer: Cows, camels, sheep, and goats.

questions.question: What does their milk show?
questions.answer: That Allah provides gentle and pure food for people.

questions.question: What soft part of plants is said to go through hard ground and rock?
questions.answer: The roots and little root hairs.

questions.question: What does this show about hard things like rock and dirt?
questions.answer: They are under Allah’s command.

questions.question: What happens to green leaves during strong heat?
questions.answer: They stay fresh and keep their wetness for a long time.

questions.question: Which prophet is mentioned when the passage talks about a staff striking rock?
questions.answer: Prophet Musa, peace be upon him.

questions.question: Which prophet is mentioned when the passage talks about fire becoming cool?
questions.answer: Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What main idea is answered with “Yes, it is so”?
questions.answer: That all things show, in their own way, that they act with Allah’s name.

questions.question: What surprising thing does the town example describe one person doing?
questions.answer: Forcing all the people of a town to gather and work.

questions.question: What would make that possible for him?
questions.answer: Support from a ruler and official authority.

questions.question: How is the town example like the rest of creation?
questions.answer: Just as the man uses a ruler’s power, created things work with Allah’s power.

questions.question: Why are seeds and grains amazing in the passage?
questions.answer: Because very small things grow into huge trees.

questions.question: What does the passage say trees are doing for us?
questions.answer: Bringing us gifts from Allah’s mercy.

questions.question: Why are gardens spoken of like kitchens?
questions.answer: Because many different foods come out of them.

questions.question: What food from animals is especially talked about?
questions.answer: Milk.

questions.question: What is amazing about the roots of plants and grasses?
questions.answer: They are soft, but they still go through hard earth and rock.

questions.question: What lesson does that give about strength?
questions.answer: Real strength comes from Allah’s command.

questions.question: What other weak-looking part of a plant is mentioned besides roots?
questions.answer: Thin green leaves.

questions.question: What do those leaves do in very hot weather?
questions.answer: They keep their moisture.

questions.question: What does the passage say to people who think heat and hardness control everything?
questions.answer: Even heat and hardness obey Allah.

questions.question: What miracle is used to help us understand roots splitting rock?
questions.answer: The miracle of Musa, peace be upon him, striking the rock.

questions.question: What miracle is used to help us understand leaves facing heat?
questions.answer: The miracle of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, when fire was made safe.

questions.question: What is being explained through examples in this passage?
questions.answer: That all things work in Allah’s name.

questions.question: When a person seems to do a huge job alone, what should we understand?
questions.answer: He must have help and authority greater than himself.

questions.question: In the town picture, whose strength is really behind the work?
questions.answer: The king’s strength.

questions.question: In the same way, whose strength is behind the work of creation?
questions.answer: Allah’s strength.

questions.question: What little things are said to hold up huge trees?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: What can we learn from a tiny seed making a giant tree?
questions.answer: Allah gives great power to small things.

questions.question: What do trees hand over to people, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Nourishment and gifts from mercy.

questions.question: How do gardens help people?
questions.answer: They bring out many kinds of food.

questions.question: Which animals in the passage are examples of Allah’s provision?
questions.answer: Cows, camels, sheep, and goats.

questions.question: What comes from these animals for people to drink?
questions.answer: Milk.

questions.question: Why is the milk a sign of mercy?
questions.answer: Because it is pure and beneficial food given to us.

questions.question: What makes the roots seem surprising?
questions.answer: They are very soft, yet they pass through very hard places.

questions.question: What does the passage say becomes obedient to roots and plants?
questions.answer: Hard earth and rock.

questions.question: What two things are said to challenge the ideas of naturalist thinkers?
questions.answer: Roots breaking through rock and leaves staying moist in heat.

questions.question: What does the mention of Musa, peace be upon him, help us picture?
questions.answer: How roots can open rock by Allah’s command.

questions.question: What does the mention of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, help us picture?
questions.answer: How leaves can be safe in strong heat by Allah’s command.

questions.question: What does the passage say all beings do by their state and condition?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s name.

questions.question: What is the first proof given from daily life?
questions.answer: A man could not control a whole town by his own power.

questions.question: If he is not acting alone, what is he acting with?
questions.answer: Official power from the ruler.

questions.question: How does this help us understand the world?
questions.answer: It shows that created things do their work with Allah’s power.

questions.question: What are the smallest examples named first in creation?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: What heavy and huge result do they bring?
questions.answer: Great trees.

questions.question: What does the passage say trees receive and then offer?
questions.answer: Mercy from Allah and its gifts for us.

questions.question: Why are gardens compared to places where meals are made?
questions.answer: Because many different foods come from them.

questions.question: Which four animals are called blessed in the passage?
questions.answer: Cows, camels, sheep, and goats.

questions.question: What flows from these animals for people?
questions.answer: Milk.

questions.question: What does this teach us about Allah?
questions.answer: He is the Provider who gives us food.

questions.question: What soft plant parts are named as moving through hard places?
questions.answer: Roots and tiny rootlets.

questions.question: What happens to those roots when they meet rock and soil?
questions.answer: They go through them.

questions.question: What claim about nature is being pushed back against?
questions.answer: The idea that nature works by itself without Allah.

questions.question: Which strong things are said to still be under command?
questions.answer: Heat and hardness.

questions.question: What is the big lesson from roots, leaves, rock, and heat together?
questions.answer: Everything obeys Allah.

questions.question: What statement about creation is checked at the start of this passage?
questions.answer: Whether all things, in their own way, say Allah’s name.

questions.question: In the example, why would a single person driving a town’s people seem impossible by himself?
questions.answer: Because that work is too great for one person alone.

questions.question: What would prove he has special backing?
questions.answer: He is working as a soldier with the ruler’s authority.

questions.question: What is the matching truth about the world?
questions.answer: All things act by Allah’s permission and power.

questions.question: What does the passage point to in seeds and grains?
questions.answer: Their ability to bring out very large trees.

questions.question: Why is that a sign for us?
questions.answer: It shows great results coming from tiny things by Allah’s power.

questions.question: What do trees provide that shows mercy?
questions.answer: Food and benefits for people.

questions.question: Why are gardens described as if they were cooking many dishes?
questions.answer: Because they grow many kinds of things to eat.

questions.question: Which animals are named as a source of nourishment?
questions.answer: Cows, camels, sheep, and goats.

questions.question: What special drink do they give?
questions.answer: Milk.

questions.question: How should we think about that milk?
questions.answer: As a caring gift from Allah.

questions.question: What surprising job do very soft roots do?
questions.answer: They enter and pass through hard rock and earth.

questions.question: What does that tell us about Allah’s name and command?
questions.answer: By Allah’s command, even hard things become easy to overcome.

questions.question: What are leaves able to keep during great heat?
questions.answer: Their moisture.

questions.question: What two prophets are brought in as examples in this passage?
questions.answer: Musa and Ibrahim, peace be upon them.

questions.question: Why are their stories mentioned here?
questions.answer: To help show that Allah can control rock and fire, and everything else too.

questions.question: What question opens the target passage?
questions.answer: Whether all beings truly say Allah’s name through how they are made and how they act.

questions.question: What picture is given to help answer that question?
questions.answer: A lone man making a whole town’s people move and work.

questions.question: Why would we know that man is not using only his own strength?
questions.answer: Because such a big action needs higher authority and power.

questions.question: In the example, what job does the man have?
questions.answer: He is like a soldier.

questions.question: After that example, what does the passage say about all things?
questions.answer: They act in Allah’s name.

questions.question: Which tiny things are said to carry giant living things?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: What giant living things come from them?
questions.answer: Trees.

questions.question: What do trees and gardens give to people?
questions.answer: Different foods and blessings.

questions.question: What are gardens compared to so children can imagine them better?
questions.answer: Big pots or kitchens making many foods.

questions.question: Which animals are listed as giving a pure drink?
questions.answer: Cows, camels, sheep, and goats.

questions.question: What is that drink?
questions.answer: Milk.

questions.question: What does the passage say about tiny roots?
questions.answer: They are soft, but they still push through rock and soil.

questions.question: What does that show about the world?
questions.answer: Everything is under Allah’s rule.

questions.question: What do green leaves do even when the weather is very hot?
questions.answer: They stay moist.

questions.question: Who are the people criticized for trusting only nature?
questions.answer: Naturalist philosophers.

questions.question: What is the main lesson from the whole passage?
questions.answer: Allah gives power to all created things, and they work by His command.
